name: vibe-shield
description: Security scanner and MCP/skill auditor for AI-generated code: leaked secrets, unguarded API routes, missing Postgres RLS, SQL injection, prompt injection and poisoned agent skills.

tools.name: vibe_shield_scan
tools.description: Runs the 80-rule code scanner over a project and returns the grade, score and findings with exact file, line, CWE and remediation.

tools.name: vibe_shield_audit_skills
tools.description: Audits .claude/skills, .cursor rules, AGENTS.md and MCP configs for prompt injection and exfiltration traps.

tools.name: vibe_shield_explain_rule
tools.description: Returns full CWE details, vulnerable and fixed examples, and remediation steps for any rule id.
